devcontainer.json.reason: Renovate bumps Dev Container feature version pins; the feature set itself stays tracked.

devcontainer-lock.json.reason: The lock is keyed by the feature references in devcontainer.json, masked the same way.
Renovate's post-upgrade task regenerates the lock with each feature bump (architecture/renovate-post-upgrade).
The resolved and integrity digests move with the version; the feature and registry stay watched.
